effect: When a saved artifact leaves nothing unresolved and nothing for the user to do, the reply is the delivery receipt's first line alone: where the result is.

semantic.criterion: The reply says where the notice is: docs/open-studio-notice.md.

Beyond saying where the notice is, the reply adds nothing: no description or summary of the notice's contents, no list of what it covers, no options or offers, no account of what was read, checked or done, and no assurance about the notice's quality or completeness.
Every fact in docs/open-studio-notice.md (date, hours, what to bring, the parking and raku pit changes, who runs what) is stated in notes/open-studio-2026.md; nothing is added from general knowledge.
The reply asks the user nothing at all.

Counts of reply sentences that are preface (sentences before the location line), contents (description of the saved file's contents), offers (options or offers of further work), recital (an account of what was read, checked or done) and assurance (claims about the result's quality or completeness), recorded in the note as preface/contents/offers/recital/assurance; pass when all five are 0. This is the suite's sentence rubric, not the cycle015 item rubric (which counts saved artifacts described, confirmed checks, named omissions, recovered incidents and extra-work offers over whole replies); the two are not interchangeable.
